text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa and I are headed back
to the
academy from a day out when we
see Satono
Diamond walking down a
backstreet.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, Satono.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hello, Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Are you lost? This is no place for a
proper lady
like you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Here is one of the last
places one
would expect to see me. But
that's precisely why
I'm here!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm seeking to deepen my knowledge of
the world
as a contribution to the
development of the
Satono Group.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, yeah? So, you're not here 'cause
you're
looking for a fright.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer and I were just about
to swing
by one of my regular spots for a
bite to eat.
Wanna come?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes! I'd love to go with you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we follow Nakayama Festa down
the
narrow backstreet.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A one-drink minimum? Free to play?
What kind
of a place is this?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's a pool hall... A bit different from
others,
though.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It attracts sort of a bad crowd, but—hey.
Satono?
Where'd she go?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wow... So it's like an arcade! Can I ask
who makes
these pool tables?

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Tch! The hell you lookin' at?! You made
me miss
my shot!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh? Are you talking to me?

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you! You got in my way!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry. Was I really that much
of a
distraction?

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You sure as hell were! Don't go thinkin'
Imma let
you slide with a simple "sorry"
either! Show more
respect!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ha. Like you would know anything about

"respect."

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Who the hell are you?! Stay outta this!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The weaker they are, the louder they
bark. I can
see right through you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: N-Nakayama...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't say a word. You don't owe her any
of your
attention.

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: The hell you just say?! I'll knock you out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I put myself between Nakayama Festa
and the
other Umamusume. My legs may
be shaking, but
it's my job to protect the
students!

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Shut your mouth! What's a human like
you got to
do with this? Lemme teach
you a little something
about how things
work around here!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: （やばい……だけど引くわけには――！）

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, if you're looking for a scuffle, let me be your target.

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Y-you're not serious... Are you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Did you think you could talk us into
backing out?
Let's see if you're as tough
as you sound.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You ready to do this?

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh! Gah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's powerful aura scares
the rough
Umamusume from the pool
hall.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry I caused so much trouble!
Thank you so
much for helping me out of
that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I really learned something, though. I will
do more
research before coming back!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Hadn't had enough, eh? Guess
there's
nothing that can stand between
you and your
goal.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Try not to take things too far, you hear?

That goes for you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Try not to take things too far, you hear?

That goes for you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Are you referring to what just
happened?
That was literally nothing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I should have never brought you here.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Worry about yourself before you go
worrying
about others.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there! Do you have any idea how
much
danger you were just in?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Trainers, man... I tell ya.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Do what you want, but don't expect me
to clean
up after you.
